findings.summary: Source export size formatting is duplicated instead of consumed by the production caller.
findings.consequence: The exported helper is currently exercised by tests but not used by the source download UI, so future threshold or label changes can drift between individual file size formatting and aggregate download size formatting.
findings.evidence: `rg` shows `formatLibrarySourceExportSize` is imported only by `test/unit/library-contract.spec.ts`; the production component `app/components/library/LibrarySourceDownloadWorkspace.vue` repeats the same `size < 1_050_000 ? Math.round(size / 1024) ... : toFixed(2)` logic for `downloadSizeLabel`.
findings.recommendation: Import `formatLibrarySourceExportSize` in `LibrarySourceDownloadWorkspace.vue` and use it for `downloadSizeLabel`, or keep the logic local there and remove this exported helper plus its direct test import.
